newsitem.title: VIETNAM: Vietnam sells 70 bln dong T-notes, rate 8.0 pct.
newsitem.headline: Vietnam sells 70 bln dong T-notes, rate 8.0 pct.

text.p: Vietnam sold 70 billion dong ($6.35 million) worth of one-year Treasury notes with an annual coupon of 8.0 percent to domestic institutions at an auction on Wednesday, an official at the State Bank of Vietnam said.
At the last auction of government paper, on September 23, the central bank issued 70 billion dong worth of one-year Treasury notes at a rate of 8.30 percent.
The issue date of the notes sold on Wednesday is October 4, 1996 and maturity will be on October 2, 1997, a statement said.
The bank said allotments of stock, in dong, were as follows:
Bank for Foreign Trade of Vietnam (Vietcombank) 53,200 billion
Vietnam Commercial Joint Stock Bank for
Vietnam Technical and Commercial Joint Stock Bank
